record.original_question: Let V_T be the Frobenius variety of numerical semigroups admitting a Toms decomposition. Determine whether V_T is the least Frobenius variety containing all numerical semigroups of embedding dimension 2.

evidence.quote: Every semigroup with embedding dimension two admits a Toms decomposition. Is the variety of numerical semigroups admitting a Toms decomposition the least Frobenius variety containing all semigroups with embedding dimension two?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A numerical semigroup is a subset $S \subseteq \mathbb{N} = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$ that is closed under addition, contains $0$, and has finite complement in $\mathbb{N}$. Its embedding dimension is the cardinality of its (unique) minimal system of generators. A Frobenius variety is a nonempty family $\mathcal{V}$ of numerical semigroups satisfying:
(i) if $S, T \in \mathcal{V}$ then $S \cap T \in \mathcal{V}$;
(ii) if $S \in \mathcal{V}$ and $S \neq \mathbb{N}$, then $S \cup \{F(S)\} \in \mathcal{V}$, where $F(S) = \max(\mathbb{N} \setminus S)$ is the Frobenius number of $S$.

A numerical semigroup $S$ is said to admit a Toms decomposition if there exist numerical semigroups $S_1, \dots, S_n$, each of embedding dimension $2$, such that
$$S = S_1 \cap S_2 \cap \cdots \cap S_n.$$
Let $\mathcal{V}_T$ denote the family of all numerical semigroups admitting a Toms decomposition; it is known that $\mathcal{V}_T$ is a Frobenius variety, and that every numerical semigroup of embedding dimension $2$ belongs to $\mathcal{V}_T$.

Determine whether $\mathcal{V}_T$ is the least (smallest under inclusion) Frobenius variety containing all numerical semigroups of embedding dimension $2$. Equivalently, decide whether every Frobenius variety that contains all numerical semigroups of embedding dimension $2$ must contain $\mathcal{V}_T$.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a published resolution of this question. Subsequent literature on Frobenius (and Frobenius-restricted) varieties of numerical semigroups continues to develop the theory, but no source explicitly confirming or refuting that $\mathcal{V}_T$ is the least Frobenius variety containing all embedding-dimension-two numerical semigroups was located.
